text: TrainingTarget：To get your Student Visa (X visa) with a bigger possibility TrainingMethod:RemoteTrainingwithSkype:SICAS–China NumberofStudents/Class:1-5 Trainer: C.V.O , SICAS (Chief Visa Officer ) -10 years Visa Application Practical Experience -Helped thousands of International Students from all over the world to get visa to China -Especially professional for visa application of African Students, Middle East students and Asian Students. TrainingIntroduction: This training is available for the applicants to secure your success of Visa Application. It is specially designed for those who may not know how to prepare for the Student Visa Application (X visa) Documents, procedures, especially Visa Application Interview; or have difficulties in passing the interview and getting Student visa successfully for the first time. Through Online Training, you will be given comprehensive, as well as personally tailored instruction and advice about how to deal with above issues, esp. the interview offered by the China Embassy. Training Content: 1) Help students prepare the Visa Application Documents in a perfect way. 2) Familiarizing students with Visa Application Interview of China Embassy The training will prepare students for all the procedures and content included in the real visa application interview. 3) Giving detailed instruction for each applicant Students will be given personalized tips about what the visa officer will ask about you, and how to reply them in a proper way to avoid being refused by China Embassy for issuing you an Student Visa. 4) Other matters needing attention Students will also be given tips about interview etiquette, how to leave a good first impression on the interviewer and how to adjust psychological states during the interview and so on. 5) Mock interview At the end of the training, mock interview will be conducted to make sure that students have grasped all the things learned in the training.
